title: Can you stop a disaster?
questions: What are the main ideas you learned from this episode? Please give a brief summary in your own words.
Which disasters can realistically be prevented, and which can only be prepared for?
Why do people sometimes ignore warnings even when experts say danger is approaching?
Should governments force people to evacuate from high-risk areas?
What is one item or plan every household should have for emergencies?
If a disaster is unlikely but potentially catastrophic, how much money should society spend preparing for it?
